_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Airframe Fastener Usage Guidelines
summary: Establishes the engineering criterion for the selection and application of mechanical fasteners for air vehicles and aircraft stores.
use_relationship:
This document establishes the engineering criterion for the selection and application of mechanical fasteners for both air vehicles and aircraft stores. The overall objective of this document is to provide design activities or integrated product teams (IPTs) with fastener subsystem standard policies and design information; it documents selection and application information for fastening systems and procedures so the designers or IPTs can achieve an optimum balance of performance, reliability, and standardization with minimum cost, logistic inventory and maintenance.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract SOW.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-82231.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Airframe Fastener Usage Guidelines shall contain the following:

children.title: Fastener Usage Approach
children.content: Describe the approach for developing and implementing uniform requirements applicable to aerospace fasteners that are capable of preserving the structural integrity and material compatibility of the system's elements being joined. The approach shall address fastener attributes such as: the process for development of fastened joint allowables; designation of external and internal thread form; definition of minimum diameter of structural fasteners; definition of drive and wrenching element configurations; identification of usage limitations specific to external and internal threaded fasteners, washers, inserts, studs and pins, rivets and blind fasteners, door and access panels, single point linkages, potential for galvanic corrosion).

children.title: Describe controls to optimize performance, reliability
children.content: and quality of fasteners while minimizing cost, fastener variety, logistic inventory and maintenance tasking.

children.title: Describe the contractor's engineering knowledge base
children.content: of fasteners and their appropriate application (i.e., a compilation of contractor best practices and lessons learned for designers/design teams who must select and apply various fasteners to system components).

children.title: Describe exceptions and/or deviations from
children.content: the JSSG-2009 Fastener subsystem guidelines as applicable to the system with justification for the exception and/or deviation.

children.title: Joining Methods
children.content: Describe processes for joining and securing airframe/store structural members, air vehicle/store components, access panels, and doors while preserving the structural integrity of the elements being joined.

children.title: Common Fasteners
children.content: Describe the plan for use of common fasteners without compromising performance.
